description: This file is a shell script (.sh) used for automated testing of CVS and Git repository operations, including setting up CVS modules, importing, updating, and verifying revisions in a test environment.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites before running tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test that is expected to succeed, with dependencies and commands specified.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or outputs.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_tree
methods.description: Compares branch trees in repositories; used at the end for verification.
